title: Jazz is Everywhere
lyrics:
[Verse]
The best way to describe jazz
Is that it's just jazz
There's no metaphor or simile or witty words
It's just jazz

[Chorus]
Jazz is everywhere
It's even right here
In this song

[Verse]
I can sing the praises of jazz
And still it's just jazz
I could scat a bunch of made-up words like "ba-ba-bop"
But that's jazz

[Chorus]
Jazz is everywhere
It's even right here
In this song
Jazz is everywhere
It's even right here
In this song

[Verse]
Jazz is like jazz
And it has jazz in it
Because it's jazz
That's why it's jazz
[Chorus]
Jazz is everywhere
It's even right here
In this song
Jazz is everywhere
It's even right here
In this song
